name: S2000 Smart Watch – 7-in-1 Full Touch Bluetooth Calling Fitness Tracker with Multi-Sport Modes & Health Monitoring (Unisex)
description:
S2000 Smart Watch – Full Specifications
General Information

Model: S2000 Smart Watch

Applicable Users: Unisex

Body Material: Alloy / Zinc Alloy (model-dependent)

Band Material: Silicone / Rubber (comfortable & durable)

Watch Shape: Square / Round (model-dependent)

Compatibility: Android & iOS Devices

Touch Screen: Full Touch

Watch Faces: Multiple customizable faces

Connectivity & Smart Features

Bluetooth: BT 3.0 / 4.0 / 5.0 (supports Bluetooth calling)

Call Function: Make & receive calls, Caller ID, Call Logs

Smart Notifications: SMS, WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Skype, Line, WeChat

App Support: Compatible with HiWatch PRO / Proprietary App

Health & Fitness Features

Heart Rate Monitoring

Blood Pressure & Blood Oxygen (SpO₂) Measurement

Sleep Monitoring

Step Counter & Calorie Tracker

Sports Modes: Walking, Running, Cycling, Climbing, Indoor Running, and more

Additional Reminders: Sedentary Reminder, Water Intake Reminder, Breathing Exercises

Battery & Charging

Battery Capacity: 220–300mAh (depending on model)

Battery Life: 2–7 Days (based on usage)

Charging Mode: Wireless Magnetic Charging / USB Charging

Charge Time: 2–3 Hours

Other Functions

Raise Wrist to Wake Screen

Music & Camera Control

Alarm, Stopwatch, Calendar, Calculator

Anti-Lost Feature

Silent / Low Power Mode

Package Includes

1 × S2000 Smart Watch

1 × Charging Cable

1 × User Manual

7 Interchangeable Straps (optional edition)

1 × Retail Box
